sources.quote: Material: EN AW-6082-T6. Not interchangeable with EN AW-6061: different alloy, lower yield.
Special characteristic SC-BR220-YS: yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa, see control plan line 30.

findings.why: The drawing in force (rev C) requires EN AW-6082-T6 with yield of at least 250 MPa. The proposed EN AW-6061-T6 is a different alloy with typical yield of 240 MPa, which is below the special characteristic.

sources.quote: no change to an approved part or its process may be implemented without the written approval of Aurelia.
front subframe bracket for the Aurelia Torre (PRG-X)

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to the Aurelia program PRG-X. A material change to an approved part needs Aurelia's written approval before shipment. No approval or valid deviation covers it. DEV-114 and DEV-118 are expired and concern other parts or topics.
The documents contain no 3.1 material certificate for EN AW-6061-T6 for BR-220. A person must say whether one exists.
